candidates.name: Scientific-purpose-preserving laboratory transfer
candidates.need: Transfer experiments across equipment without silently changing measurement meaning.
candidates.existing: Protocol dependence graphs, SiLA, PRISM, and proposed LAP.
candidates.gap: Independent physical equivalence evidence and minimal discriminating experiment.
candidates.why_now: Frontier tools can assemble dependencies and counterexamples; no physical-performance gain measured.
candidates.construction: Purpose contract, device compatibility witness, experimental discriminator.
candidates.test: Blind transfer with measured output equivalence.
candidates.falsifier: Existing expert workflow equals full cost, or simulator evidence cannot establish equivalence.
candidates.economics: Lab transfer service plus co-funded generic adapter; demand and obligations unknown.

candidates.name: Observation-qualified methane intervention
candidates.need: Translate alerts into authorized funded repairs with defensible cessation evidence.
candidates.existing: UNEP MARS detection/verification and World Bank GFMR financing.
candidates.gap: Small-case preparation, unavailable closure information and split obligations.
candidates.why_now: Public alert data and frontier coordination may lower preparation burden.
candidates.construction: Observation-aware obligations and contingent closure/finance plan.
candidates.test: Archived incidents with future withheld, compared with actual expert workflow.
candidates.falsifier: No underserved buyer segment or no independent outcome ascertainment.
candidates.economics: Project preparation/verification fee; not gas savings treated as sales.
candidates.status: deferred: gap and customers insufficiently grounded

candidates.name: Operational exit options
candidates.need: Maintain service obligations after SaaS supplier loss when its original software cannot be licensed.
candidates.existing: Sophisticated verified SaaS escrow and migration providers.
candidates.why_now: Expert model use may reconstruct semantics from configuration and behavior.
candidates.construction: Negative and positive acceptance contracts, rights-cleared converters.
candidates.test: Two independent real tools plus fresh recipient and missing-feature refusal.
candidates.falsifier: Existing service matches price/scope or export cannot preserve essential behavior.
candidates.economics: Shared adapter commissioning plus customer-specific continuity contract.
candidates.status: deferred: crowded market and unverified underserved niche

candidates.name: Evidence continuity contracts
candidates.need: Know which quantitative conclusions survive a changed source without rebuilding all provenance.
candidates.existing: Crossref/Scite/RetractoBot alerting; Cochrane impact framework; EPPI/MetaLab/Dynameta living analyses.
candidates.gap: Legacy reconstruction into portable, scoped, executable revalidation with refusal for unresolved semantics.
candidates.why_now: Expert frontier reasoning can inspect mixed documentation, construct adapters and challenge assumptions; no guaranteed advantage.
candidates.construction: Source-to-estimate-to-model contract, original-purpose checks, update packet, portable engine and separately authorized reuse.
candidates.test: Real open secondary datasets plus unstructured metadata, known numerical references, frozen injected changes, independent full rerun and fresh recipient; ambiguous real crop narrative held.
candidates.falsifier: Incorrect or unnecessary invalidation; purpose/correlation changes pass; cheap expert already matches; full cost exceeds buyer value.
candidates.economics: Paid baseline reconstruction then optional continuity service, co-commissioning only if shared public work and participation justify it.
candidates.status: selected for bounded mechanism test; market unvalidated

candidates.name: Scientific instrument experience cooperative
candidates.need: Preserve commands/troubleshooting traces discarded by instruments so future research can learn from expert operation.
candidates.existing: FAIR/PIDINST/PROV-O metadata and scientific workflow standards.
candidates.gap: Rights, incentives, capture completeness and independent usefulness of experience traces.
candidates.why_now: Multimodal learning and connected instrumentation may make recorded interaction valuable.
candidates.construction: Opt-in trace capture, redaction, evidence and a paid cross-lab learning arrangement.
candidates.test: Consenting labs hold out instrument/domain and measure task outcomes, not archive size.
candidates.falsifier: Traces lack incremental value, secrets cannot be removed, or capture cost exceeds reuse.
candidates.economics: Access/service cooperative with explicit contributor and buyer incentives.
candidates.status: deferred: no rights-cleared interaction corpus or participating labs

candidates.name: Local fabrication qualification for open hardware
candidates.need: Make documented designs actually producible by smaller local manufacturers.
candidates.existing: Established reverse engineering, readiness scales and documentation-quality assessment.
candidates.gap: Missing tolerances, materials, process assumptions and acceptance evidence for a particular design.
candidates.why_now: Frontier visual reasoning and tool use may reconstruct qualification dossiers.
candidates.construction: Manufacturing-ready missing-information plan, explicit rights, design/inspection instrument.
candidates.test: Independent fabrication and inspection under original requirements.
candidates.falsifier: Unavailable dimensions/rights, physical acceptance fails, or established service is cheaper.
candidates.economics: Paid engineering dossier plus shared nonproprietary process capability; no current WTP evidence.
candidates.status: deferred: physical validation and specific buyer missing

reason: Most directly documented unresolved reconstruction burden, consequential research-integrity purpose, independent numerical/refusal acceptance available. Prior art narrows claim to scoped legacy reconstruction and portable continuity, not alerting or new meta-analysis. No market-validation gate is declared passed.
decision_rule: Consequence and independent need first; do not count implementation convenience as gap evidence. Candidate may be stopped if expert full rerun erases complete-cost advantage.
search_budget: Six serious candidates; at most32 primary-document reads for opportunity selection; subsequent protocol/source retrieval separate. Initial science9 successful plus3 failures, systems13 successful, root primary opportunity sources within remaining allowance. Duplicate verification reads do not add distinct documents.
